WITH seats AS (
    SELECT rs.seat, rs.session_id AS sid, rs.launched_at, rs.kind
      FROM launch.run_seats rs
     WHERE rs.run_id = $1
),
since AS (SELECT min(launched_at) AS at FROM seats),
reports AS (
    SELECT n.id, n.note_uuid, n.created_at AS queued_at, n.session_id AS worker
      FROM since
      JOIN workspace.session_notes n ON n.created_at >= since.at AND n.kind = 'report'
      JOIN seats w ON w.sid = n.session_id AND w.kind = 'worker'
),
seat_answers AS (
    SELECT r.id, min(m.queued_at) AS answered_at
      FROM reports r
      JOIN mailbox.messages m ON m.to_session_id = r.worker AND m.queued_at > r.queued_at
      JOIN seats a ON a.sid = m.from_session_id AND a.kind = 'acceptance'
     GROUP BY r.id
),
judge_answers AS (
    SELECT r.id, min(e.occurred_at) AS answered_at
      FROM reports r
      JOIN launch.fleet_events e
        ON e.run_id = $1
       AND e.kind = 'verdict_recorded'
       AND e.payload->>'note_uuid' = r.note_uuid::text
     GROUP BY r.id
),
answers AS (
    SELECT id, min(answered_at) AS answered_at
      FROM (SELECT id, answered_at FROM seat_answers
            UNION ALL
            SELECT id, answered_at FROM judge_answers) every_answer
     GROUP BY id
)
SELECT count(*) AS "reports!",
       count(a.answered_at) AS "answered!",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM a.answered_at - r.queued_at)) / 60)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS median_minutes,
       round((max(extract(epoch FROM a.answered_at - r.queued_at)) / 60)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS longest_minutes,
       coalesce(round((sum(greatest(extract(epoch FROM a.answered_at - r.queued_at) - 600, 0)) / 60)::numeric, 1), 0)::float8 AS "late_minutes!"
  FROM reports r LEFT JOIN answers a ON a.id = r.id
